text.title: Latency Budget Allocation Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the user-facing SLO to an executable CI gate: pin the SLO and its measurement point, name and instrument every hop caller-side, record fan-out stages and tighten their child percentile, allocate budgets beside measured p95 with a reserve line, fit timeouts and retries inside each hop and propagate deadlines, put a histogram bucket at each threshold, verify the composition against the end-to-end histogram, then write the gate spec and hand it to the reviewer before it blocks. Each step names the rule it satisfies and the fields of `02-output-contract.xml` it fills.

step.name: pin-the-slo-and-its-measurement-point
step.input: The user-facing SLO document; the metric it is computed from; where that metric is recorded (client, edge, load balancer, server).
step.action: Record percentile, threshold, measurement point and window as the total budget. If the budget will be measured at a different point than the SLO, allocate the difference (DNS, TLS, CDN) as its own hop with its own metric; otherwise the points must match (r-total-budget-is-user-facing-slo).
step.output: `slo`, and the `difference_hop_id` hop when the points differ.
step.decision-gate: No SLO stated as percentile + threshold + measurement point + window: stop; a budget cannot be allocated from a total that does not exist.

step.name: name-and-instrument-every-hop-caller-side
step.input: The request's critical path from traces; the metrics catalogue; team ownership.
step.action: For every hop record the service, the owning team and the caller-side latency histogram (name and labels) that measures it, so connection setup and retries are included. A hop with no histogram is instrumented before allocation continues (r-every-hop-named-and-measured).
step.decision-gate: Any hop on the critical path without a caller-side histogram and an owner: instrument it first; a hop with no metric is a guess.

step.name: record-fan-out-and-tighten-the-child-percentile
step.input: Stages that call N backends in parallel and wait for all of them.
step.action: Per fan-out stage record N, set the child budget at a stricter percentile than the stage target (the stage tail is the slowest child's tail) and name the mitigation: tighter child budget, hedged requests, or partial results after a deadline (r-fan-out-tightens-child-percentile).

step.name: allocate-budgets-beside-measured-p95
step.input: Each hop's measured p95 over the SLO window; the total from step 1.
step.action: Assign `budget_ms` per hop and show it next to `measured_p95_ms`. A hop budgeted below its measured p95 is `underwater` and carries a linked improvement ticket with an owner; a hop budgeted at more than twice its measured p95 justifies the slack. List headroom left unallocated as `reserve_ms`, never absorbed into a hop (r-budget-reconciled-with-measured-p95).
step.decision-gate: Sum of hop budgets plus reserve above the SLO threshold: reallocate; an underwater hop with no ticket: the gate is not enabled for it.

step.name: fit-timeouts-and-retries-and-propagate-deadlines
step.input: Each hop's client timeout, retry count and backoff; the RPC framework's deadline support.
step.action: Per hop compute the worst case (timeout x attempts + backoff) and cap timeout and attempts so it fits inside `budget_ms`. Enable deadline propagation so a hop never works past a budget its caller has already blown (r-timeouts-and-retries-fit-the-hop).

step.name: put-a-bucket-boundary-at-each-threshold
step.input: The histogram bucket configuration per hop metric.
step.action: Check that each hop's histogram has a bucket boundary at, or within 10% of, its `budget_ms`; where it does not, file the bucket change as a prerequisite task before the gate is enabled (r-histogram-buckets-at-budget-thresholds).

step.name: verify-the-composition-against-the-end-to-end-histogram
step.input: The end-to-end histogram at the SLO's measurement point over the SLO window.
step.action: State the composition model (sum of budgets plus reserve is at most the total) as an allocation constraint only; verify that the budget holds by reading the measured end-to-end percentile from the histogram with its request count. Never present a sum of per-hop percentiles as the end-to-end percentile (r-percentiles-do-not-add).
step.decision-gate: End-to-end measured percentile above the threshold: the allocation is a plan, not a pass; the underwater hops' tickets are what closes the gap.

step.name: write-the-gate-spec-and-hand-it-to-the-reviewer
step.input: The perf environment; the load tool; `templates/output.md.j2`.
step.action: Write the exact load command, the environment, the minimum request count per run, a percentile threshold per hop and end to end, and the failure action (block merge, or warn with a named owner). Never gate on the mean. Validate with `scripts/validate-latency-budget-allocation.py --file`, set `review.status = ready_for_review`; the owning team's reviewer approves the thresholds before the gate blocks merges, and the agent does not enable a blocking gate (r-ci-gate-spec-is-executable; human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`).
step.decision-gate: Reviewer not named or validator failing: the gate runs in `warn` at most until approval.

list.item: SLO pinned with measurement point and window; every critical-path hop has a caller-side histogram and an owner; fan-out stages carry N, a stricter child percentile and a mitigation.
Every hop budget sits beside its measured p95; underwater hops have tickets, slack is justified, reserve is its own line; sum plus reserve is at most the threshold.
Timeout x attempts fits every hop; deadlines propagate; a bucket boundary sits at every threshold or a task is filed.
Composition verified against the end-to-end histogram over the window; the CI gate is percentile-based, reproducible from the artefact, and not set to block by the agent.
